svg.title: Projects. Before moving into cognitive science I worked in data analytics at Bosch and completed the NextLeap product fellowship, which trained me in hypothesis driven user research and measurement. Research: The Song or the Self (preregistered EEG study of music and emotion); Study Hub (study dashboard for cognitive science). Built with AI: Blinkit Intent to Basket (tell it the outcome, it builds the basket); Shopping AI Assistant (cart aware grocery picks with explanations); Mutual fund FAQ assistant (facts only answers with an official source link); Wealth Monitor (AI personal finance coach for Indian users); AI Discovery Engine (themes across large sets of app reviews); Nykaa Fit (size recommendation experiment with an A/B test); Recruiter Info (a job search tool that validates every posting); Claude job plugin (job discovery and tracking inside Claude). Product thinking: Prioritization, Metrics and Growth (why urban Indian users avoid voice input); Engati pitch (business case scored against six KPIs); Eureka teardown (removing the language barrier); n8n teardown (blank canvas paralysis in onboarding); Portfolio. Links are listed below this image.
